summary: République centrafricaine's NDC ecosystem pledges span restoration, conservation, and agriculture, anchored in its vast forest cover (83% of the national territory). Restoration targets include reforesting 1,000,000 ha of deforested landscapes by 2030 and restoring 9,300–20,900 ha of degraded forests and savannas. Conservation aims to reduce slash-and-burn agriculture's share in deforestation from 90% to 83% by 2030, make 12.5–25% of firewood extraction renewable, and protect 20% of the sequestration capacity of key protected areas. Agriculture pledges focus on expanding agroforestry (up to 100,000 ha by 2030), increasing organic fertilizer use to 3,000 t, and boosting food NTFP production by 30%. Cross-cutting commitments include 7 new land use plans and a 50% reduction in land productivity loss by 2030, with the country's carbon sink targeted to grow from 394,624 to 409,369 GgCO₂-eq by 2035.
